text:
liam: Heads up — planning a config-only deploy at 18:40 PT. Changes: routing policy weight tweak, global token timeout 30s -> 25s, per-model batch cap 256 -> 192. Dry-run canary 10% for 15m then ramp to 50% with 30m guardrail.

deploy-bot: Deploy requested by liam. CI checks: passed. Canary target: service=inference, config=cfg-2330123456. ETA: 18:43 PT.

molly: what's the reason for lowering the token timeout? latency spikes earlier?

eva: yep — noticed tail latencies at p95 around 28s during long sequences. lowering to 25s keeps requests on the sync path shorter and should failover to async for heavy tails. we'll watch p95/p99.

yun: please pin model version v2.3.1 for the window to avoid auto-rollover during the change.

liam: pinned v2.3.1 in release config and added a fallback route to the smaller instance pool if p95 increases > 30% vs baseline.

molly: can we keep batching conservative? proposal: 256 -> 192 to reduce queueing.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 20:18:12 UTC for cfg-2330123456 on inference-canary. 10% traffic. Observability: https://redir/obs/cfg-2330123456

eva: seeing a small tail bump isolated to zone us-west-2b — if p99 > 2x baseline for 3 consecutive mins we should trigger partial revert on that zone.

molly: prepping rollback note. If we revert, restore batch cap to 256 and timeout to 30s, and remove routing exclusion.

liam: rollback playbook prepared:
``n1) `rctl apply config cfg-rollback-2330123456`
2) scale routing weights back to previous set
3) notify oncall and start incident channel
```

oncall-bot: @molly assigned for the next 30m — escalation thresholds set: p95 +40% or errors +0.5%.

deploy-bot: Canary at 10% stable for 6m. Metrics: errors +0.02%, p95 +5%, p99 +12%.

eva: numbers are within expected delta. proceed to ramp to 50% over 10m. keep 30m warm guardrail.

liam: Ramping now.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 50% initiated. Expected completion 20:35:00 UTC.

molly: watching logs — small spike in retries originating from one ASG, pinging infra to check.

yun: infra confirmed noisy hosts in that ASG; added exclusion rule in routing policy for those hosts.

deploy-bot: Ramp complete. 50% traffic. Compare dashboard: https://redir/obs/compare/2330123456

eva: after exclusion p99 returned to baseline. holding for the 30m guardrail window.

molly: if green at 30m, I'll mark release notes: "config-only: timeout reduced to 25s, batch cap 192, routing fallback/exclusion enabled, model v2.3.1 pinned"

liam: thanks — updating release notes and setting canary TTL to 6h.

deploy-bot: Canary TTL set to 6h. Thread will be closed unless alerts fire. :party_parrot:
